top5.what_zh: DeepSeek released dsh-superagent, an MIT-licensed research prototype that turns GitHub and Feishu requests into parallel worker sessions. In DeepSeek’s own simulation, p95 task completion fell to 15.7 minutes from 29.5 minutes. top5.title: datasette-llm 0.1a9
top5.summary: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a9 I have some big upgrades to Datasette Agent in the pipeline, but in the meantime here's a tiny user experience improvement to the underlying datasette-llm plugin. It now picks up the default model used by LLM , which means you can start using Datasette Agent without needing to explicitly configure a default model: uvx --with data

editorial.trend_zh: 本期动态显示 AI 创新正从模型发布延伸到工具与业务应用，实际价值取决于能否解决具体任务。
editorial.core_zh: 企业可先选边界清晰的流程做小规模验证，记录质量、成本和人工接管；普通人则先掌握一套可复用的 AI 工作流，把工具用在真实任务上。
editorial.trend_en: This issue points to AI moving beyond standalone answers toward tools that can execute work inside real workflows; wider adoption also raises questions about cost, reliability and governance.
editorial.core_en: Organizations can start with a bounded workflow and measure quality, cost and human handoff. Individuals can learn one reusable AI workflow and apply it to a real task instead of chasing every model release.
